description: Auth failure cluster — distributed 401/403 surge from multiple IPs, credential stuffing
evidence_text:
Auth failure surge detected in namespace multi-agent, service api-gateway. Business error class: auth_failure (401/403). Access log analysis over last 10 minutes:

Total requests: 8,400. 401 responses: 5,040 (60%). 403 responses: 1,260 (15%). Total auth failures: 6,300 (75% of all traffic).

Distribution: Failures from 340 unique source IPs across 12 countries. Top IPs: 203.0.113.10 (180 fails), 198.51.100.20 (165 fails), 192.0.2.55 (158 fails). Endpoint targeted: POST /api/v1/auth/login. Request rate: 840 req/min (14x normal). User-Agent diversity: 15 distinct user agents (not a single bot). Credential format: all requests contain valid email format with rotating passwords (credential stuffing pattern). Internal auth service reports: 6,250 failed authentication attempts against 3,100 unique email addresses. Account lockout triggered on 47 accounts.
